title: 菲奥娜·银线长廊
description: 菲奥娜在白石长廊自持站定，黑短发与红色发束清楚，细剑始终入鞘，蓝白衣装受冷暖侧光切分。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Fiora is an adult Demacian duelist with a precise dark bob, a striking pink-red hair streak, pale eyes, and an aristocratic composed face. Preserve her blue-white tailoring and shoulder armor with a fully covering fitted jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and tall boots. Her slender ornate rapier remains securely sheathed at her side, the guard visible but no blade drawn or fencing posture.
art_direction.scene: She stands at a slight three-quarter angle in a monumental pale corridor, one hand resting lightly near the sheathed guard without drawing it and the other behind her back. Hard window light traces her profile and silver trim. Long receding shadows, a single distant arch, and rough decisive wax-crayon planes give the quiet pose precision and authority.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, ivory, rose-red accent, silver gray
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
